data.title: The model on the first table
data.goal: The model on the first table

memoryNodes.cue: Sam introduces the study of body structures.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 萨姆介绍研究身体结构的学科。

memoryNodes.cue: He points out a part of the face.
The pictures show structures and positions at different scales.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 图画展示不同尺度的结构与位置。

data.situation:
Sam took the visitors to the first table. A book of anatomy lay open beside a model of a human body. He pointed to its head and then to the jaw at the lower part of the face. The model was simplified, but it helped people ask where structures were. A close-up drawing beside it showed tissue as groups of cells working together, while a second card explained that an organ contains different kinds of tissue. Anatomy studies the structure of bodies.
The heart is an organ.
The drawing beside the model shows tissue at a different scale. Visitor: Why is there a sketch of someone sitting beside the model?
Sam: It shows posture—the position in which someone holds their body.
Visitor: Does the artist show more than one position?
Sam: Yes. There is one person standing and another leaning forward to read.

readingBlocks.en: Sam took the visitors to the first table. A book of anatomy lay open beside a model of a human body. He pointed to its head and then to the jaw at the lower part of the face. The model was simplified, but it helped people ask where structures were. A close-up drawing beside it showed tissue as groups of cells working together, while a second card explained that an organ contains different kinds of tissue.
readingBlocks.zh: 萨姆带访客来到第一张桌。人体模型旁摊着一本解剖学书。他先指头部，再指脸下部的颌。模型经过简化，却能帮助大家提出有关位置的问题。旁边的放大图把组织画成共同工作的细胞群，第二张卡片说明一个器官包含不同类型的组织。

readingBlocks.en:
Anatomy studies the structure of bodies.
The heart is an organ.
The drawing beside the model shows tissue at a different scale.
readingBlocks.zh:
解剖学研究身体结构。
心脏是一个器官。
模型旁的图画用不同尺度展示组织。
readingBlocks.title: Beside the model

readingBlocks.en:
Visitor: Why is there a sketch of someone sitting beside the model?
Sam: It shows posture—the position in which someone holds their body.
Visitor: Does the artist show more than one position?
Sam: Yes. There is one person standing and another leaning forward to read.
readingBlocks.zh:
访客：模型旁为什么有一张人坐着的速写？
萨姆：它展示姿势，也就是身体保持的位置。
访客：画家展示了不止一种姿势吗？
萨姆：对。一个人站着，另一个前倾阅读。

glossary.zh: 解剖学；研究身体结构的学科
glossary.note: 本例为学科；不是某种组织内部结构的比喻义。
glossary.example: The open book is an introduction to anatomy.
glossary.exampleZh: 摊开的书是解剖学入门。

externalEvidence.definition: the branch of morphology that deals with the structure of animals

glossary.note: 身体上部包含脑、眼等的部分；不是领导或标题。
glossary.example: Sam pointed to the model’s head.

externalEvidence.definition: the upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals; contains the face and brains

glossary.note: 保留原下巴释义；jaw并非严格等于chin下巴尖端。
glossary.example: He pointed to the jaw at the lower part of the face.

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Lower-face region; not silently replacing chin with bone-only definition.

glossary.zh: 由细胞组成、共同发挥功能的组织
glossary.example: The drawing shows tissue made up of groups of cells.
glossary.exampleZh: 图画展示由细胞群构成的组织。

externalEvidence.definition: part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function
a fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function

glossary.note: bodily posture；态度、立场义未计覆盖。
glossary.example: The artist drew the visitor’s seated posture.
glossary.exampleZh: 画家画了访客坐着的姿势。

externalEvidence.definition: the arrangement of the body and its limbs
